ops.value: Searchable UI/UX data (Python 3): product-type design systems, palettes, font pairings, UX guidelines, charts, icons, stack notes. Invoked by the dfw workflow as a data source; its picks are recommendations, not decisions. Use directly only when the user names UI UX Pro Max.
ops.why: Upstream description claims every UI task; in dfw it is a supporting data source (precedence level 5).
macOS and many Linux systems ship python3 without a `python` alias.
